questions.questionText:
A student exposed a fly larva to light and temperature gradients.
They lit the area from one side and made one side of the area warmer than the other.
They traced the path of the fly larva’s movement.
warm
fly larva
light dark
cold
path taken by
the fly larva
Which statement describes the response of the fly larva?

options.text: The fly larva does not respond to temperature or light intensity.
The fly larva moves away from a higher temperature and a higher light intensity.
The fly larva moves away from a higher temperature and towards a higher light intensity.
The fly larva moves towards a higher temperature and away from a higher light intensity.

questions.questionText: Which statement about plant support is correct?

options.text: The pressure of water inside the cells presses inwards on the cell walls.
The pressure of water inside the cells presses outwards on the cell walls.
The pressure of water outside the cells presses inwards on the cell walls.
The pressure of water outside the cells presses outwards on the cell walls.

questions.questionText: What is a correct statement about active transport?

options.text: Particles move into cells, using energy released by photosynthesis.
Particles move across a cell wall without using energy.
Particles move from a region of higher concentration to a region of lower concentration.
Particles move across a cell membrane, using energy released by respiration.

questions.questionText: Which word describes a fertilised cell?
Which secondary sexual characteristic is caused by both testosterone and oestrogen?
What do genes code for?

When white-flowered pea plants are crossed with red-flowered pea plants, the offspring plants all
have red flowers.
If these offspring plants are crossed, the next generation of plants contains both red-flowered and
white-flowered plants.
Which statement explains this?

options.text: The allele for red flowers is dominant, and the offspring plants are heterozygous.
The allele for red flowers is dominant, and the offspring plants are homozygous.
The allele for red flowers is recessive, and the offspring plants are heterozygous.
The allele for red flowers is recessive, and the offspring plants are homozygous.

questions.questionText: What is a description of an adaptive feature?

options.text: an inherited characteristic that helps an organism to survive and reproduce
the differences between individuals of the same species
the genetic make-up of an organism
the transmission of information from generation to generation

questions.questionText: Which statement about conservation is correct?

options.text: Captive breeding programmes can be used to conserve endangered species.
Climate change is reducing the number of species that are endangered.
Habitat protection increases the number of species that are endangered.
